archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / DARKROOM CONTROL SURFACE
design_concept: A precision darkroom workstation and optical laboratory interface for cinema & photography professionals. Blends high-density metadata displays with dark obsidian surfaces, tactile glowing sliders, and color wheel inspector panels.

typography.font_pairings: Outfit (Display & Headings) + Inter (Interface & Body) + JetBrains Mono (Technical EXIF, Color Grades & Coordinates)

rules.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-100
rules.label: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider text-amber-400/90

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: MODE B - High Density Studio Grid for analytical data & side-by-side split visual inspection
layout_and_spacing.card_style: bg-[#12151E] border border-white/10 rounded-xl p-5 shadow-2xl backdrop-blur-md

components_and_features.header_nav: Glassmorphism header (bg-[#0A0C10]/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 z-50 fixed top-0 w-full). Includes logo with aperture icon, main navigation tabs (Analyzer, Public Gallery, Preset Library, Camera Specs Database), media upload quick button, and darkroom preset mode indicator.
components_and_features.upload_zone: Interactive drag-and-drop dropzone supporting JPG, PNG, WEBP, RAW, MP4, MOV files. Shows live upload preview with progress bar, EXIF quick scan preview, and sample demo files button for instant analysis.
components_and_features.analysis_dashboard: Split-view control center with original media preview (with zoom/loupe tool & color picker), technical metadata card grid (Device, Lens, Resolution, Bit Depth, FPS, Megapixels, Software), and Color Grading Formula tabbed panel.

color_grading_formula_panel.basic_tone: Interactive sliders for Temperature (K), Tint, Exposure (EV), Contrast, Highlights, Shadows, Whites, Blacks
color_grading_formula_panel.hsl_matrix: 8-color matrix (Red, Orange, Yellow, Green, Aqua, Blue, Purple, Magenta) with Hue, Saturation, Luminance bars
color_grading_formula_panel.color_wheels: 3-Way Color Wheels for Shadows (Lift), Midtones (Gamma), Highlights (Gain) with vector point targets
color_grading_formula_panel.mood_description: Natural language summary of atmospheric tone, contrast curve, and lighting style
color_grading_formula_panel.preset_export: Copy preset buttons for Lightroom (.xmp / slider values), DaVinci Resolve node tree, and CUBE 3D LUT snippet

components_and_features.public_gallery: Filterable mosaic grid of community analyzed photos/videos. Filterable by Camera Brand (Sony, Canon, FUJIFILM, RED, ARRI, iPhone), Editing Software (DaVinci Resolve, Lightroom, Capture One, Premiere Pro), Mood Tone, and Resolution.
components_and_features.analysis_detail_modal: Full-screen or side-by-side modal displaying high-res visual comparison, dominant color palette swatches with hex codes, EXIF telemetry block, and copyable color grading recipe.

darkroom_gear.description: Camera equipment, lenses and light table with film strips

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete full-stack hybrid web application for ChromaLens AI in React JS and FastAPI.

Ensure all key functionalities are fully working: media file drag-and-drop upload/analysis simulator (extracting EXIF camera metadata, resolution, bit depth, megapixels, software, and generating realistic Lightroom/DaVinci grading values), detailed formula inspector with copyable parameters and CUBE LUT snippet, and interactive public gallery with search & filters.

Apply data-testid attributes to all interactive elements, buttons, inputs, tabs, gallery items, and sliders (e.g. data-testid='upload-dropzone', data-testid='copy-preset-button', data-testid='gallery-filter-camera', etc.).
Use Lucide icons (lucide-react) for technical HUD indicators, sliders, camera icons, copy buttons, and export actions.
Use sonner for instant toast feedback when copying color grading formulas or presets to clipboard.
Maintain the dark darkroom theme aesthetics (#0A0C10) with sharp typography contrast, glowing slider tracks, and color swatch indicators.

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.anti_slop: Do not make a generic SaaS blue dashboard. Ensure this looks like a professional colorist darkroom application with rich matte dark backgrounds, titanium text, and glowing amber/cyan data readouts.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast: All text must meet high APCA/WCAG contrast against dark darkroom surfaces. Use explicitly text-slate-100, text-slate-300, or text-amber-400.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_transparent_header: Header must use backdrop-blur-xl with semi-opaque dark background (bg-[#0A0C10]/85).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.test_ids: Add data-testid to every interactive button, tab, card, and form element.
